title: Venturo User-Generated Content & Community Guidelines
summary: Venturo is built around discovering things to do, meeting people with similar interests & helping people spend more time experiencing the world around them.
meta: Business: Viatori Ventures (Pty) Ltd trading as Venturo

blocks.text: Venturo is built around discovering things to do, meeting people with similar interests & helping people spend more time experiencing the world around them.
Community features may allow Users to:
These Guidelines explain what is acceptable when contributing content or interacting with others through Venturo.
They apply together with the Venturo Terms & Conditions and Privacy Policy.
By posting or contributing User-Generated Content through Venturo, you agree to follow these Guidelines.
User-Generated Content, or UGC, includes content created or submitted by Users rather than Venturo.
other information submitted through community-facing features.
Use Venturo in a way that helps people discover, participate & connect safely.
Share information you reasonably believe to be genuine.
Do not use Venturo to harm, deceive, threaten or exploit other people.
Venturo does not permit content or behaviour that targets another person with:
encouragement for others to harass someone.
Personal attacks, threats & targeted abuse are not.
Users may not post content that promotes hatred, serious discrimination, dehumanisation or violence against people based on characteristics protected by applicable law.
Content intended primarily to intimidate, degrade or attack individuals or groups may be removed.
Discussions involving sensitive social issues may be permitted where they remain respectful & lawful.
glorify serious violence in a way that creates a safety risk;
threaten venues, businesses or other Users; or
use Venturo to facilitate criminal activity.
Credible threats may be escalated to the appropriate authorities where reasonably necessary or required by law.
Venturo is an activity, event & community discovery platform.
Pornographic or sexually explicit material is not permitted in public community areas.
Content involving sexual exploitation, sexual violence or sexual content involving minors is prohibited.
Venturo may remove sexually suggestive material where it is inappropriate for the feature, community or audience in which it appears.
Users must not post content that exploits, sexualises, endangers or inappropriately identifies a child.
Users should take particular care when uploading photographs containing children.
A User should only upload identifiable photographs of children where they have an appropriate right or permission to do so.
Venturo may remove content involving children where there is a legitimate privacy or safety concern.
Serious concerns relating to child safety may be referred to the appropriate authorities.
Do not publish another person's private or sensitive information without an appropriate reason or permission.
other information that could create a safety or privacy risk.
Venturo may remove personal information where publication could reasonably cause harm or violate applicable privacy law.
Reviews should reflect a genuine experience with the relevant activity, business, event or service.
Users should aim to describe what happened rather than deliberately attacking the people involved.
posted in exchange for undisclosed compensation;
used for blackmail or extortion; or
submitted primarily to manipulate a business's rating.
A negative review is not automatically a violation.
Venturo will not remove a review simply because a business disagrees with it.
Venturo may investigate reviews where there is evidence that they are fake, abusive, fraudulent or otherwise breach these Guidelines.
Businesses, employees, owners, agencies or closely connected persons must not submit misleading reviews intended to artificially improve the rating of their own business.
Businesses must also not create fake accounts to post negative reviews about competitors.
Where Venturo identifies organised review manipulation, relevant reviews may be removed and the associated account or business may be restricted.
Users remain responsible for the statements they publish.
Knowingly false accusations, fabricated claims or unlawful defamatory content may be removed.
Only upload photographs or videos that you have the right to share.
Do not upload photographs or videos simply because they were found online.
Where identifiable people are the primary subject of an image, Users should consider whether those people reasonably expect or have agreed to the image being publicly shared.
Users must respect copyright, trademarks & other intellectual property rights.
Do not upload or reproduce content that belongs to another person or organisation unless you have permission or another lawful basis to do so.
Copyright complaints may be submitted to:
Venturo may temporarily restrict or remove disputed content while investigating a legitimate intellectual-property complaint.
Further information may be provided in Venturo's Copyright & Intellectual Property Policy.
Parody or commentary must not be presented in a manner intended to deceive Users into believing it is an official account.
Venturo communities should remain useful to the people participating in them.
Businesses may promote themselves only through features or communities where commercial participation is expressly permitted.
Users may not use Venturo to:
misrepresent an activity or service; or
manipulate another User into making an illegitimate payment.
Suspected fraud may result in immediate restriction of the relevant account while the matter is investigated.
Content that facilitates or actively encourages unlawful activity may be removed.
Venturo may restrict accounts being used for illegal purposes.
Where reasonably required by law, Venturo may preserve relevant records or cooperate with authorised law-enforcement or regulatory authorities.
Venturo is built around discovering activities, some of which may naturally involve physical risk.
Users may discuss legitimate recreational activities such as hiking, climbing, cycling or adventure experiences.
Users should not encourage others to deliberately ignore safety requirements, trespass, bypass venue restrictions or participate in activities in an obviously dangerous or unlawful manner.
Content encouraging, glorifying or instructing people to seriously harm themselves may be restricted or removed.
Where Venturo reasonably believes there is an immediate & credible risk to someone's safety, appropriate action may be taken.
Individual Venturo communities may have additional rules based on their purpose.
For example, a hiking community may set rules relating to:
Community-specific rules apply in addition to these Guidelines.
Where community rules conflict with these Guidelines or applicable law, these Guidelines & applicable law take priority.
Users should be able to report content that they believe breaches these Guidelines.
Reports should be made using the reporting functionality available within the Venturo Platform where possible.
Copyright-related reports may be sent to:
Venturo will review legitimate reports as soon as reasonably possible.
Users may report another User where they believe that person is behaving in breach of these Guidelines.
A report does not automatically mean that the reported User has violated Venturo's rules.
Venturo may review relevant Content, account activity & other information reasonably necessary to investigate the report.
Where supported by the applicable feature, Users may block another User.
Blocking may prevent or restrict the blocked User from:
appearing within certain parts of your Venturo experience.
The exact effect of blocking may depend on the feature involved.
Blocking a User does not automatically report them to Venturo.
Where conduct breaches these Guidelines, Users should also use the Report function.
Venturo may use automated tools, manual review or a combination of both to help identify Content that may breach these Guidelines.
The action taken will depend on factors such as:
whether the conduct appears intentional; and
whether other Users are at risk.
Venturo may take immediate action without prior warning where Content or behaviour involves a serious risk, including:
another serious violation requiring urgent intervention.
A pattern of smaller violations may result in stronger enforcement.
Repeated warnings, repeated removal of Content or attempts to evade moderation may lead to temporary or permanent account restrictions.
Creating another account to evade a suspension or ban may result in the new account also being restricted.
Moderation decisions may sometimes require additional context.
If you believe Venturo has removed your Content or restricted your account incorrectly, you may contact:
why you believe the decision should be reconsidered; and
Venturo may review the decision but is not required to restore Content that continues to breach these Guidelines, the Terms & Conditions or applicable law.
Venturo may allow Activity Providers to respond to reviews.
Business responses must follow the same standards as User Content.
offer incentives in exchange for removing legitimate criticism; or
Users retain ownership of original User-Generated Content they submit.

By submitting Content to Venturo, Users grant Venturo the licence described in the Venturo Terms & Conditions to host, display, store, format & use the Content as reasonably necessary to operate the Platform.
Submitting Content does not transfer ownership of it to Venturo.
31. Removal Does Not Mean Ownership Changes
If Venturo removes Content because it breaches these Guidelines, this does not mean Venturo claims ownership of that Content.
Removal is a moderation decision concerning whether the Content may remain available through the Venturo Platform.
Venturo may preserve, disclose or provide information to an authorised regulator, court or law-enforcement authority where legally required or otherwise permitted under applicable law.
Venturo will handle personal information in accordance with its Privacy Policy & applicable data-protection requirements.
Venturo may update these Guidelines as the Platform & its community features develop.
Changes may be made to address:
The latest version will be published through the Venturo Platform or website.
Questions or concerns regarding these Guidelines may be sent to:
Copyright or intellectual-property concerns may be sent to:
